summary: Interior Dang's least documented monsoon fall, near Barda village. For completists willing to ask directions and accept a rough approach.
description:
Barda is deep-cut Dang: a seasonal waterfall near Barda village that appears in district eco-tourism material and local knowledge but almost nowhere else. Reports describe a forest fall in the Purna catchment reaching strength in peak monsoon, with an unmarked approach, village lanes, then footpath, that changes with the year's washouts.

This record exists to be verified: location, route and current access all need ground-truthing before the dataset can recommend a visit plan. If you go, go in August–September, hire a local guide at the village, and treat it as an exploration with a waterfall at the end rather than a destination with facilities: it has none.
highlights: Undocumented monsoon fall in the Purna catchment
Local guide from Barda village essential
